x: David Davies, a City of London Policeman and son of Stan Davies, took part in the recent Barking - Southend 34 miles walk. In only his second appearance he finished 25th of the 139 starters.

David Davies ran a well deserved 2nd place whilst another face to reappear after a long absence from the athletic scene was Bob James in 3rd spot---some shady training in the Coulsdon area indicated here; no doubt catching the habit from near neighbour Clive Shippen!!.
The race was also something of a City of London Police convention, with our own John Kelly and David Davies in the field, together with policeman Wilde, 36th in 46m. 41s.
